verdict.rationale: Agent Studio connects a chosen LLM to Algolia search and grounds responses in live index data, supporting conversational search, shopping assistants and content summarizers, with completion caching. The Search API serves as the documented retrieval layer, NeuralSearch adds hybrid vector retrieval, and the Crawler can build RAG-optimized indexes. missing for 10: explicit Agent Studio answer/completions API reference details (endpoints, request/response shapes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG/conversational answer quality.
